name: Missouri

agency.name: Missouri Department of Labor and Industrial Relations, Division of Labor Standards

rates2026.note: Retail or service businesses with annual gross sales under $500,000 are exempt from the state minimum wage (RSMo 290.500)

minWage.smallEmployer: Retail or service businesses with annual gross sales under $500,000 are not covered by the state law (federal $7.25 may apply under the FLSA).

tipped.note: 50% of the state minimum wage; tips must bring total pay to $15.00

minWage.other: 2025 law HB 567 ended the annual cost-of-living indexing: the rate stays at $15.00 after 2026 unless the law changes.

source.quote: the minimum wage established by this subsection shall be increased by $1.25 per hour, to $15.00 per hour, effective January 1, 2026.

overtime.note: Time and a half after 40 hours in a workweek.

source.quote: No employer shall employ any of his employees for a workweek longer than forty hours unless such employee receives compensation ... not less than one and one-half times the regular rate

sickLeave.capNote: Proposition A (2024) required paid sick leave from May 1, 2025, but HB 567 repealed it effective August 28, 2025.
sickLeave.note: No statewide paid sick leave requirement since 2025-08-28.

finalPay.fired: on the day of discharge (employee may request payment be sent; penalty wages if not received within 7 days of the written request)
finalPay.quit: no state statute sets a deadline for workers who quit (federal law sets none either)
finalPay.ptoNote: No Missouri statute requires payout of accrued vacation; follows employer policy or contract.

source.quote: the unpaid wages of the servant or employee then earned at the contract rate ... shall be and become due and payable on the day of the discharge

notes.text: Paid sick leave approved by voters in Proposition A (November 2024) was repealed by HB 567, effective August 28, 2025.
Since August 28, 2025, the state minimum wage also applies to public employers (state, cities, counties, school districts).

source.quote: Beginning on August 28, 2025, the provisions of this section shall apply to a public employer with respect to its employees.

notes.text: Service letter: a corporation with 7+ employees must, on written request by certified mail from an employee with 90+ days of service, issue a letter stating the nature of service and the true cause of departure within 45 days.

source.quote: it shall be the duty of the superintendent or manager of said corporation to issue to such employee, within forty-five days after the receipt of such request, a letter
